decisions.reason: The waterproof lined safety shoe range sits squarely within the firm's footwear and materials know-how, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret results and refine the line, so keeping it fits absorptive-capacity logic.

Electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoes build directly on the firm's established safety-footwear competence and are a staple of industrial demand, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve the product.

This safety shoe series is close to the core offer and supported by the firm's own development and prototyping capabilities, though series in this segment are refreshed periodically, which carries some modest risk of replacement.
